post_operation: NULL check on returned pointer before subsequent dereference / use
critical_variable: priv->pFirmware (the pointer returned by kzalloc and stored into a struct field)
path_conditions: kzalloc may return NULL on allocation failure
Without a NULL check, priv->pFirmware is dereferenced later in rtl8192_adapter_start
The enclosing function's signature changes from void to int so the error can be propagated to the caller
